comparison.objective: Sort four pages from an accessible pile into a tray in numerical order, temporarily staging obstructing pages.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-page edge grasping, singulation, staging, and ordered placement; no impact fracture or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Pages 4-to-1 are correctly stacked in the tray. No detailed numeric rubric is provided.
comparison.reason: Tests rearrangement planning and thin-object handling, not coaxial tool alignment, controlled hammer fracture, retained-insert protection, or loose-tang containment.
